newsitem.title: USA: Aprogenex says delisted from AMEX.
newsitem.headline: Aprogenex says delisted from AMEX.

text.p: Aprogenex Inc said Tuesday the American Stock Exchange (AMEX) has denied its appeal for continued listing on the AMEX.
Aprogenex said its last day for trading its common stock on the AMEX will be June 6.
The company said that in anticipation of this decision, it is taking the necessary steps to begin trading on the Electronic Bulletin Board.

Aprogenex develops, manufactures and markets rapid DNA probe-based test systems based on its proprietary RIGHTechnology, which is applicable to extensive markets in genetics, oncology, virology and microbiology.
